title: Notion Agent API alpha routes and Update agent status endpoint are deprecated
symptoms: Private alpha agent routes flagged deprecated after Agent APIs went generally available
Update agent status endpoint marked deprecated
cause: The Agent APIs left beta on 2026-11-02. The private alpha routes are deprecated, and the separate Update agent status endpoint is replaced by PATCH /v1/agents/{agent_id}.
fix: Move off the alpha routes to the GA ones and send status through Update an agent instead of the status endpoint.
affected: Integrations using private alpha agent routes or Update agent status, from 2026-11-02
